description: This file defines the NIT class within the Thunder::Broadcast::DVB namespace, representing a Network Information Table (NIT) for DVB broadcasting. It includes nested classes for iterating over network entries and provides methods for accessing network data and descriptors.

classes.name: NIT
classes.description: Represents a DVB Network Information Table with methods to access network descriptors and iterate over network entries.

classes.name: NIT::NetworkIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing network entries within the NIT, providing methods to access transport stream ID, original network ID, descriptors, and network count.

methods.name: NIT::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the NIT object contains valid data.

methods.name: NIT::NetworkId
methods.description: Returns the network ID associated with the NIT.

methods.name: NIT::Descriptors
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the descriptors associated with the NIT.

methods.name: NIT::Networks
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the network entries contained in the NIT.

methods.name: NIT::NetworkIterator::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current network iterator position is valid.

methods.name: NIT::NetworkIterator::Reset
methods.description: Resets the network iterator to an initial state.

methods.name: NIT::NetworkIterator::Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next network entry.

methods.name: NIT::NetworkIterator::TransportStreamId
methods.description: Returns the transport stream ID of the current network entry.

methods.name: NIT::NetworkIterator::OriginalNetworkId
methods.description: Returns the original network ID of the current network entry.

methods.name: NIT::NetworkIterator::Descriptors
methods.description: Returns an iterator over descriptors for the current network entry.

methods.name: NIT::NetworkIterator::Networks
methods.description: Returns the number of networks in the current network entry.
